description: nf-core/methylseq samplesheet context for WGBS / RRBS / EM-seq analyses.
validation_rules: fastq_1/fastq_2 may be HTTPS URLs (ENA mirror) or local paths.
Single-end libraries leave fastq_2 blank but retain the column header.
Methylation kit/protocol (e.g., bismark vs bwameth) is selected via pipeline params, not the samplesheet.

population_priority: One row per library/run; combine lanes by repeating the sample value.
Carry NExtSEEK metadata into treatment/tissue/donor/condition columns.
